welcome:
👋 Hello, {name}!

Just send me one of these — no menus, I'll figure out what to do:

🔗 A link (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, Pinterest) → I'll download the video
🎵 A song name or artist → I'll search and list matches
🎤 A voice message or audio clip → I'll identify the song
🎬 A video file → I'll identify its music and can extract the MP3

Type /help anytime, or /language to switch language.
help_text: Just send me something — I route automatically, no menu needed: 🔗 A link from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, or Pinterest → I download the video (or images) for you automatically. 🎵 A song name or artist (plain text) → I search and show up to 10 numbered matches to pick from. 🎤 A voice message or audio file → I try to identify the song. 🎬 A video file → I identify its music and offer to extract the audio as MP3. Commands: /help, /language If something doesn't work, I'll tell you exactly why.
ask_send_audio_for_recognition: 🎤 Send a voice message, audio file, or a short video clip and I'll try to identify the song.
recognizing_in_progress: 🎧 Listening… identifying the song, this takes a few seconds.
recognition_no_match: 😕 I couldn't confidently identify this track. It might be too short, too noisy, or not in the database. Try a longer or clearer clip.
recognition_low_confidence_prefix: ⚠️ I'm not fully sure, but this might be it:
recognition_error: ⚠️ Music recognition failed right now. Please try again in a moment.
recognition_file_too_long: ⚠️ That file is quite long — I'll only analyze the first {seconds} seconds.
ask_send_link: 🔗 Send me a public link from Pinterest, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, or X.
ask_send_video_for_conversion: 🎬 Send me a video file, or a supported video link, and I'll extract the audio as MP3.
choose_download_option: 📥 Choose what you'd like to download:
choose_download_option_carousel: 🖼 This post has {count} images. Choose one, or download all.
sending_large_file_link:
📦 This file is larger than Telegram allows for direct delivery. Here's a secure temporary download link (expires in {minutes} minutes):
{url}
choose_video_action: 🎬 What would you like to do with this video?
auto_download_started: ⬇️ Got your {platform} link — downloading the video now, one moment…
auto_download_images_started: 🖼 Got your {platform} link — fetching the images now…
video_identifying_music: 🎬 Got your video — identifying the music now…
result_actions_expired: ⌛ This media is no longer available for that action — please send the link again.
search_no_results: 😕 I couldn't find any track matching “{query}”. Try a different spelling, or add the artist name.
search_results_header: 🎵 Results for “{query}” — page {page}/{total_pages}. Tap a number:
search_expired: ⌛ This search expired. Please send the song name again.
search_error: ⚠️ Music search failed right now. Please try again in a moment.
search_preview_caption: 🎧 {artist} — {title} 🎵 30-second preview (not the full track). Use the button below for the full song.
search_no_preview: 🎵 {artist} — {title} No playable preview is available for this track. Here's the official link:
error_unsupported_platform: ❌ Sorry, I don't support this link yet. Supported platforms: Pinterest, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X.
error_platform_disabled: ❌ Downloads from this platform are temporarily disabled by the admin.
error_unsafe_url: ❌ That link isn't valid or safe to fetch. Please double-check it.
error_private_content: 🔒 This content is private or requires login, so I can't access it.
error_login_required: 🔐 I couldn't fetch this anonymously — the platform is currently rate-limiting or requiring a login for this link. This is not the same as the content being private. If you're the operator, adding a cookies file lets the bot access it; otherwise please try again later.
error_content_not_found: ❌ I couldn't find this content — it may have been deleted, or the link is invalid.
error_rate_limited: ⏱ The platform is rate-limiting requests right now. Please try again in a bit.
error_file_too_large: ❌ This file ({size_mb:.0f} MB) exceeds the {limit_mb} MB limit and can't be processed.
error_download_failed: ❌ Download failed. Please try again, or try a different link.
error_download_timeout: ⌛ This is taking too long and timed out. Please try again.
error_media_invalid: ❌ That file doesn't look like a valid audio/video file.
error_ffmpeg: ❌ Something went wrong while processing the media. Please try again.
error_generic: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
error_rate_limit_user: ⏱ You're sending requests too quickly. Please wait {seconds}s and try again.
error_file_too_big_to_fetch: ❌ That file is larger than {limit_mb} MB, which is the maximum I can download from Telegram.
error_banned: 🚫 You've been restricted from using this bot. Contact the admin if you think this is a mistake.
error_maintenance: 🛠 The bot is under maintenance right now. Please try again soon.
job_queued: ✅ Got it, working on it now…
admin_not_authorized: 🚫 This section is for admins only.
admin_pick_quality: Choose the default quality for automatic video downloads:
admin_pick_media_type: Which caption template do you want to edit?
admin_send_new_template:
Send the new {media_type} caption template.

Available variables: {{title}}, {{artist}}, {{source}}, {{bot_username}}.

Current template:
{current}
admin_pick_button_media_type: Which caption(s) should this button appear under?
admin_send_button_label: Send the button's label text (what the user sees).
admin_send_button_url: Now send the button's URL (must start with http:// or https://).
admin_invalid_url: ❌ That doesn't look like a valid http(s) URL. Please send a valid URL, or /cancel.
admin_pick_limit_target: Which file-size limit do you want to change?
admin_send_new_limit_mb: Send the new limit in MB for {target} (a whole number).
admin_invalid_number: ❌ That's not a valid whole number. Please try again, or /cancel.
admin_send_broadcast_text: Send the announcement text you want to broadcast to all users.
admin_broadcast_started: 📤 Broadcast started, sending to {user_count} users. This runs in the background.
admin_operation_cancelled: ❌ Cancelled. Back to the admin menu.
